title: Law to require public notice before buildings become shelters
summary: This bill would require builders converting or constructing hotels and similar buildings into shelters to file an operation statement disclosing the planned capacity, population served and operator. The statement would be shared with the local borough president, Council member and community board, and published online before the Department of Buildings issues a permit. Owners would have to update the statement within 7 days of any material change, and the law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
